caseNameFull: James C. Davis, as Agent, etc. v. W. M. Scroggins
summary: Error to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Ras Young and Mr. George Thompson for plaintiff in error. Mr. Cone Johnson, Mr. James W. Edwards and Mr. Fred V. Hughes for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 3 of the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726, 727.
